analysis_status: post-review retrospective analysis; target outcomes already known

controls.source_calibration_transfer: no claim that source calibration is valid on shifted target projects
controls.free_volume_threshold_optimization: deferred; not run in this bounded exact-workload audit

cost_scenarios.interpretation: fixed illustrative costs; no empirical review efficacy claim

bootstrap.method: exact ordinary even-n empirical bootstrap median distribution; no random resampling
bootstrap.quantile_definition: smallest support point with CDF >= requested probability
